description: Issues a DRAFT Clio bill: awaiting payment, due in 30 days. Does not email it or apply a payment. A first call returns a preview; a second call with confirm true and that preview_id applies the change. Sign-in required.

bill_id.description: Clio bill id (digits) of a DRAFT bill, from list_matter_bills.

confirm.description: false or omitted returns a preview; true applies the change identified by preview_id.

due_at.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to 30 days from today.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. A retry with the same key returns the first result without a second write. Defaults to preview_id.

preview_id.description: preview_id is the id returned by this tool's preview call. Required when confirm is true.

name: issue_bill
title: Issue draft bill
